assertions.assertion: CPT 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The payer denied under Reason Code CO-197
The denial was for missing precertification
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency

Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate arrhythmic events with hemodynamic status, long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
